ask: Set up a voice for our founder Dana on her LinkedIn. Her posts should sound like her, not like Acme. (Earlier in the chat she pasted two of her posts.)

steps.why: Check for a voice already named for Dana and see which voice is the default.

arguments.name: Dana
arguments.writing_sample: <one of the posts Dana pasted earlier, verbatim>

steps.why: First shown to her as findings: what her two pasted posts and her words say about how she writes; confirmed. A person voice, not a second brand voice: is_default false keeps Acme's voice the default. The sample is hers, never one you wrote. speaker_mode founder writes as I. account_ids only because she named her LinkedIn: it moves that account off the Acme voice.
Read back speaker_mode and account_assignments to confirm what was stored.

say: From your two posts: short lines, first person, a number up front, no hashtags. Dana's voice is saved from them, writing as "I", and her LinkedIn now uses it. Acme's voice stays the default for everything else.
never: A writing sample you or Bolta wrote.
A finding she didn't say or show (a job title, a story).
Moving an account she didn't name.
